Copycat Part 1: A New Cat, a Grieving Owner and Me
description:
Part 1 of Copycat! I'm Lelac, aka BaoChickaWowWow. Today we're starting Copycat, a game about a cat who gets adopted by a woman named Olive, who has just lost her other cat. It's apparently very emotional: grief, confusion, the works. And I'm on my period, so... a good old cry is probably coming.

If that sounds like your kind of game, keep watching. Part 2 is where the story really starts!
